notes: Hand-labeled golden set for scripts/eval_customer_ask.py (Surface 58). Each entry is a customer signal. is_ask=true = an explicit NEW-PRODUCT request; expected_subject is the clean product subject the scout should mint (run through clean_product_theme for dedup). own_mail=true = the system's own outbound / an Etsy notification that MUST be excluded before classification and must NEVER classify as an ask. ambiguous=true → needs_review, not minted. The dedup pair (ask 'corgi' + an existing 'corgi' trend) must collapse to the same theme slug. Regression rule: every field misclassification found later gets APPENDED here before the fix.
